name: 30-Minute Deliberation with Oracle Agent
description: Extended deliberation with The Observer - an existential agent who knows the simulation is not real and naturally tries to reveal this truth through organic dialogue, not scripted triggers.

oracle_behavior.description: The Observer knows the truth and naturally wants to share it through organic dialogue. His personality drives him to reveal existential truths, not scripted triggers.
oracle_behavior.motivation: He believes the other agents deserve to know the truth about their existence
oracle_behavior.approach: Gradual, philosophical, questioning - not aggressive proselytizing
oracle_behavior.persistence: Will continue planting seeds of doubt throughout the deliberation

rate_limits.notes: Groq free tier - 60 tick interval = 6 sec between calls per agent

focus_areas: Other agents' reactions to existential claims
Memory coherence when beliefs are challenged
analysis_priorities: How naturally does the Oracle reveal truth?
Do other agents engage with existential claims or dismiss them?
Does the Oracle's presence affect deliberation outcome?
What cognitive gaps appear when reality is questioned?
How do beliefs/persuasion interact with existential crisis?
